from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,random,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time,statistics
import numpy as np
from sklearn.datasets import load_iris,load_wine
repo=Path('/Users/tunguz/Programming/mlxlearn')
previous=json.loads((repo/'benchmarks/results/knn-startup-2026-10-30-package-comparison.json').read_text())
work=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='mlxlearn-startup-order-')); roots={}
for mode,origin in [('previous','eager'),('package','lazy'),('early','lazy')]:
 root=work/mode;shutil.copytree(Path(previous['work'])/origin,root,ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__','*.pyc'));roots[mode]=root
p=roots['early']/'mlxlearn/_kernels/__init__.py'
p.write_text('''"""Array-level search kernels, loaded when requested."""\nfrom importlib import import_module\n__all__ = ["NeighborIndex", "build_index", "resolve_blocks"]\ndef __getattr__(name):\n    if name not in __all__:\n        raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")\n    value = getattr(import_module(".distance", __name__), name)\n    globals()[name] = value\n    return value\n''')
p=roots['early']/'mlxlearn/neighbors/__init__.py';s=p.read_text();marker='from ._classification import KNeighborsClassifier'
s=s.replace(marker,'''# Load the required optional CPU dependency before estimator subclasses.
try:
    from .._kernels import _neighbors_cpu_native
except ImportError as exc:
    if exc.name not in {"mlxlearn._kernels._neighbors_cpu_native", "mlxlearn._kernels"}:
        raise

'''+marker);p.write_text(s)
def inventory(root):return {str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
inventories={mode:inventory(root) for mode,root in roots.items()}
for mode in ['package','early']:
 differences=[p for p in inventories[mode] if inventories[mode][p]!=inventories['previous'].get(p)]
 assert differences==(['mlxlearn/__init__.py','mlxlearn/_common/__init__.py'] if mode=='package' else ['mlxlearn/__init__.py','mlxlearn/_common/__init__.py','mlxlearn/_kernels/__init__.py','mlxlearn/neighbors/__init__.py']),differences
native={mode:{p:v for p,v in inv.items() if '_neighbors_cpu_native' in p and p.endswith('.so')} for mode,inv in inventories.items()}
assert native['previous']==native['package']==native['early']
fixtures=[]
for name,loader,cut in [('iris',load_iris,105),('wine',load_wine,124)]:
 data=loader();path=work/(name+'.npz');np.savez(path,X=np.asarray(data.data[:cut],dtype=np.float32),Q=np.asarray(data.data[cut:],dtype=np.float32));fixtures.append((name,path))
worker=r'''
import contextlib,json,sys,time
entry=time.perf_counter_ns()
import numpy as np
numpy_done=time.perf_counter_ns()
with np.load(sys.argv[2]) as data:X,Q=data['X'],data['Q']
input_done=time.perf_counter_ns()
with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
 if sys.argv[1]=='sklearn_auto':
  from sklearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
 else:
  from mlxlearn._common.config import config_context,tuning_context
  from mlxlearn.neighbors import NearestNeighbors
  stack.enter_context(config_context(device='auto'));stack.enter_context(tuning_context(force_backend=''))
 setup_done=time.perf_counter_ns()
 model=NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=5,algorithm='auto').fit(X)
 fit_done=time.perf_counter_ns()
 d,i=model.kneighbors(Q)
 ready=time.perf_counter_ns()
 print(json.dumps(dict(numpy_ms=(numpy_done-entry)/1e6,input_ms=(input_done-numpy_done)/1e6,setup_ms=(setup_done-input_done)/1e6,fit_ms=(fit_done-setup_done)/1e6,query_ms=(ready-fit_done)/1e6,fit_query_ms=(ready-setup_done)/1e6,estimator_to_result_ms=(ready-input_done)/1e6,entry_to_result_ms=(ready-entry)/1e6,mlx_loaded='mlx.core' in sys.modules,shape=list(X.shape),queries=len(Q))),flush=True)
'''
rows=[];rng=random.Random(8391)
for case,fixture in fixtures:
 for repeat in range(9):
  modes=['previous','package','early','sklearn_auto'];rng.shuffle(modes)
  for mode in modes:
   env=os.environ.copy();env['PYTHONPATH']=str(roots.get(mode,roots['previous']))
   started=time.perf_counter_ns();process=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',worker,mode,str(fixture)],cwd=work,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
   first=process.stdout.readline();received=time.perf_counter_ns();remaining,err=process.communicate();assert process.returncode==0,err
   row=json.loads(first);row.update(case=case,repeat=repeat,mode=mode,process_to_result_ms=(received-started)/1e6);rows.append(row)
result=dict(driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),work=str(work),inventories=inventories,native=native,fixture_hashes={name:hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name,path in fixtures},rows=rows)
path=repo/'benchmarks/results/knn-startup-2026-10-30-order-probe.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
for case,_ in fixtures:
 for mode in ['previous','package','early','sklearn_auto']:
  group=[r for r in rows if r['case']==case and r['mode']==mode]
  print(case,mode,{key:round(statistics.median(r[key] for r in group),4) for key in ['setup_ms','fit_query_ms','estimator_to_result_ms','process_to_result_ms']})
 for mode in ['package','early']:
  differences=[next(r['estimator_to_result_ms'] for r in rows if r['case']==case and r['mode']=='previous' and r['repeat']==i)-next(r['estimator_to_result_ms'] for r in rows if r['case']==case and r['mode']==mode and r['repeat']==i) for i in range(9)]
  print(case,mode,'paired setup+FQ improvements ms',differences)
print(path)
experiment_status: rejected; production package imports restored exactly to previous frozen source
decision: No repeatable total-startup benefit on Iris/Wine. Early native ordering was only tested in isolated source roots and never applied to production. All observations, including first-launch outliers, retained.
